brief: Glazed hollow clay tile silo about 18 ft across and 40 ft high: shiny tile blocks in running bond glazed in mottled plum, slate-blue and rust-brown tones that glint in the sun. A continuous vertical door slot runs the full height on the front with iron ladder rungs across it, a few grey plank door boards still in place and a weathered wooden chute board leaning at the base; broken timbers stick up at the open top. Stands in tall dry grass at the edge of bare woods.
